onscreen_lines.desc: Location: 1 - DEMOLITION Trade: 5 - Demolition & Disposal 790 - MOLINE DEMOLITION SPECIFICATION - 1.00 AL The contractor shall apply for, pay for, obtain, and forward copies of required permits to the agency: All permits as required by the City of Moline Building Department. Work to comply with all applicable Moline Codes and Ordinances. Contractor responsible for knowledge of and adherence to the above codes and ordinances. Demolish and dispose of the structure(s) cited in the bid documents, in accordance with Moline Ordinances Section 3303, "Demolition," and Sections 8-7400 through 8-7403, "Filling and Grading Requirements," as well as all other applicable City, State, or Federal regulations. Additionally, break and haul the concrete foundation walls, footings, and flooring. Do not leave any material from the house on site or use it for fill. If asbestos removal is required, this will be noted in the bid document. Keep site adequately wet during demolition to keep dust down. Contractor responsible for any icing on sidewalk and street adjacent to site. Contain water and salt as needed. When the permit is issued, also check with the City of Moline Environmental Manager regarding any erosion control measures or drainage permit the location may require. Check with the City to ensure all disconnects are complete before beginning demolition. Demolition to include: 22'x38' x 38 ' fire-damaged two-story structure and foundation; front and rear concrete steps; sidewalk running adjacent to structure and to right of way; 20' x 20' shed (Side C) rear corner of lot.
